comparison.objective: Return dropped dishwasher-rack wheels to their rail and roll the rack home; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Wheel/rail realignment and rack rolling versus setscrew access, collar adjustment, counterholding, and force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: No detailed rubric is available; the title requires restored rail engagement and travel, not controlled impact absorption.
comparison.reason: Rail recovery and damper commissioning test different mechanical abilities despite both involving constrained mechanisms.
